note: Citations that FAIL the DOMAIN topic screen but are CORRECT, adjudicated one at a time with a written reason. This registry exists so the screen is never widened to make a failure disappear. Widening DOMAIN to admit these two titles would also admit every future miscitation that happens to contain the added words - which is precisely how the bakery paper and the 'Your inbox, Mr President' editorial survived four gates. The screen stays narrow; the exceptions are named and reviewable.
review_rule: An entry here asserts that a human (or an agent run recording its reasoning) read the citing claim AND the paper's actual title and judged the attachment correct. Re-verify if the citing site changes.
